import os
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689764/attempts/e81e54f2f2424f1b8a6d71322cea1218/system/state/workspace/programs')

p=base/'task-a1c4dae1.py'
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    bg = grid[0][0]\n    for row in out:\n        occupied = [i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value != bg]\n        if occupied:\n            for i in range(occupied[-1] + 1, len(row)):\n                row[i] = 1\n    return out\n''')
